# Continuum

> The intelligent creative factory for performance marketers, designers, and agencies.

Continuum uses performance data to make better creative for organic social, paid media on Meta, and creative automation.
It reads how your posts and ads perform, makes the next creative from it, and stages new Meta ads paused for your approval.

## Key Pages
- Homepage: https://trycontinuum.ai/ — Overview of Organic+, Performance+, and Creative Automation with interactive demos, pricing (Organic+ $30/mo, Performance+ $300/mo, Creative Automation custom, run as a managed pilot), and founders.
- Social+ Plugin: https://trycontinuum.ai/social-plus — AI-powered community management and content generation plugin built for Claude.
- Design Automation: https://trycontinuum.ai/technology — In-depth look at our template scaling, automated brand spec validation, and multi-channel asset generation.

Continuum is an AI platform for modern marketing teams that automates creative production and campaign activation to deliver personalized campaigns faster.
